propositions: Four graph functions (_find_direct_blockers, _get_all_blocked_by, check_cycle_at_level, detect_newly_unblocked) have elevated cyclomatic complexity (16-22) due to duplicated reduce/filter loops and hand-rolled BFS patterns
The 'reduce_all → drop error/fsck_needed → index by id' loop is identically duplicated in _find_direct_blockers and _compute_dep_graph, driving complexity in both sites
BFS skeleton logic for traversing blocked dependencies is reimplemented separately in _get_all_blocked_by and check_cycle_at_level, each with its own queue/visited bookkeeping and exception handling
Extracting a shared load_indexed_states helper and an accumulator-returning bfs skeleton will consolidate the duplicated patterns while preserving node-set and traversal semantics

The refactored functions must maintain behavior-equivalence: _get_all_blocked_by must still exclude the seed from results and include blocks targets without backing ticket dirs, and check_cycle_at_level's membership test must remain unchanged
All four functions must measure cyclomatic complexity ≤ 8/8/8/12 respectively after refactoring, verified by regenerating .github/complexity-baseline.json with no existing tests modified
